Predeclared rules

  • First touch + width ≤0.5 ATR: First physical touch plus zone width no greater than 0.5 ATR.
  • First touch + impulse volume <0.75: First physical touch plus impulse volume below 75% of the prior source candle.
  • First touch + normal RVOL: First physical touch plus formation RVOL from 0.75 inclusive to 1.25 exclusive.
  • First touch + opposing room: First physical touch plus at least 2 structural R to the nearest opposing zone, or none.
  • First touch + width + low volume: The only three-factor candidate: first touch, width ≤0.5 ATR, and impulse/prior volume <0.75.
  • Sensitivity · first touch + width ≤0.4: Lower neighboring width threshold.
  • Sensitivity · first touch + width ≤0.6: Upper neighboring width threshold.
  • Sensitivity · first touch + volume <0.5: Lower neighboring impulse/prior-volume threshold.
  • Sensitivity · first touch + volume <1.0: Upper neighboring impulse/prior-volume threshold.
